tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: Per-jurisdiction counts of what data is available, by type.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Full detail of one traffic event by id.

tools.name: get_event_hotspots
tools.description: Geographic clusters of traffic events. Needs a plan with analytics.

tools.name: get_event_trends
tools.description: Event counts over time. Needs a plan with analytics.

tools.name: get_feature_details
tools.description: Full detail of one feature by id (for cameras, the current image/stream URLs).

tools.name: get_fuel_prices
tools.description: Fuel price series by jurisdiction, country and fuel type.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Service status: tracked resources and availability.

tools.name: get_truck_corridor
tools.description: Truck-relevant restrictions, clearances and events along a straight corridor between two points. Needs a plan with truck data.

tools.name: list_feature_groups
tools.description: List feature groups, for search_features' group filter.

tools.name: list_feature_types
tools.description: List feature types (cameras, weather stations, truck parking, restrictions...) with counts.

tools.name: list_jurisdictions
tools.description: List the jurisdictions (states, provinces, countries, regions) with their codes.

tools.name: plan_truck_route
tools.description: Compute a truck route with hazard warnings along it. Each call counts against the plan's monthly routing quota.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search traffic events (incidents, construction, closures) by jurisdiction, area, type and time.

tools.name: search_features
tools.description: Search road features (cameras, weather stations, signs, truck parking, bridge clearances, restrictions...). Page with cursor.
